name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.Hints.zero_row_hint_exposes
title: A preimage hint with a small target on a row decodes LWE samples along that row
statement: For any commutative ring, if c (H X) = f then (sigma (c H) + e) X = sigma f + e X: a short preimage X under H whose target has the small row combination f maps every LWE-type sample along the row c H to sigma f + e X.
